name: Cattle Sale Payment Redirect
description: Fraudsters impersonate the ranch or a buyer around a livestock sale and redirect six-figure auction proceeds to an attacker-controlled account.
asset: Livestock sale proceeds and banking relationships
assumptions: Bank recovery is reflected in the primary-loss estimates.
Secondary loss covers strained buyer and auction-house relationships.

name: Ransomware Hits Ranch Operations
description: Ransomware encrypts the machines running herd records, feed scheduling, and payroll; operations continue by hand while systems are rebuilt.
asset: Herd records, feed scheduling, and payroll systems
assumptions: Feeding and animal care continue manually; the loss is efficiency and rebuild.
Off-site backups exist but are weeks old.
Secondary loss covers missed contract windows during recovery.

name: Irrigation and Water Control Tampering
description: Remote well pumps and pivot controllers are tampered with or knocked offline in summer heat, risking pasture, crops, and water hauling costs.
asset: Remote well, pivot, and stock-water controllers
threat: Intruder or vandal reaching remote-control interfaces
assumptions: Animal-welfare impacts are prevented by daily checks; the loss is hauling and forage.
Summer events cost multiples of off-season ones.
Secondary loss covers crop-insurance disputes and replanting.

name: Herd Records and Genetics Data Loss
description: Breeding, genetics, and traceability records are destroyed or stolen — from device loss, sync failure, or theft — undermining certification and premium pricing.
threat: Data loss, theft, or sync failure
assumptions: Registered stock loses premium value without provable lineage.
Secondary loss covers buyer-trust damage at future sales.

name: Commodity Hedging Account Takeover
description: Attackers take over the ranch's brokerage account used for cattle and feed hedging, liquidating or opening positions before detection.
assumptions: Broker reimbursement policies are reflected in primary loss.
An unwound hedge exposes the operation to price swings until replaced.
